# ARM vertical filter wide row loads

Native Apple M4 Max, Go1.27.2 archsimd, PGO off, GOMAXPROCS1.
Parent PR35 exact34b00fb4, pinned old assembly691cd051. Fixed internal edges
8/12/16 retain all dependent arithmetic/carries and exact final packed stores.
Initial column transpose uses low8 bytes of16-byte vector row loads; incoming
packets select words1/2/3 from vector loads at column4. Existing wrapper proves
all20 columns of16 disjoint rows. Every read remains within that exact window,
including pitch20, minimal slices and unaligned starts. No padding assumption.

Fresh six balanced parent/ASM/current permutations, with unrolled narrow-load
variant first/last as a fourth control;150ms per10 public Picker fixtures.
All60 paired samples improve versus parent, zero B/op and allocs/op. Fixtures
reset the entire union of read windows within B.Loop, compare full buffers with
the separate public edge operations, and retain observable output; independent
pixel tests use scalar filter equations.

* BenchmarkVP8PickerFilterNative/pitch32/flat: 1.0989x parent, 1.0544x unrolled narrow loads, 1.7548x assembly; 6/6 faster parent and 6/6 faster assembly.
* BenchmarkVP8PickerFilterNative/pitch32/ramp: 1.1027x parent, 1.0511x unrolled narrow loads, 1.7559x assembly; 6/6 faster parent and 6/6 faster assembly.
* BenchmarkVP8PickerFilterNative/pitch32/smooth: 1.0276x parent, 1.0150x unrolled narrow loads, 0.9159x assembly; 6/6 faster parent and 0/6 faster assembly.
* BenchmarkVP8PickerFilterNative/pitch32/mixed: 1.0233x parent, 1.0123x unrolled narrow loads, 0.9166x assembly; 6/6 faster parent and 0/6 faster assembly.
* BenchmarkVP8PickerFilterNative/pitch32/noop: 1.1117x parent, 1.0713x unrolled narrow loads, 1.9994x assembly; 6/6 faster parent and 6/6 faster assembly.
* BenchmarkVP8PickerFilterNative/pitch1312/flat: 1.0932x parent, 1.0522x unrolled narrow loads, 1.7670x assembly; 6/6 faster parent and 6/6 faster assembly.
* BenchmarkVP8PickerFilterNative/pitch1312/ramp: 1.1017x parent, 1.0570x unrolled narrow loads, 1.7656x assembly; 6/6 faster parent and 6/6 faster assembly.
* BenchmarkVP8PickerFilterNative/pitch1312/smooth: 1.0300x parent, 1.0156x unrolled narrow loads, 0.9244x assembly; 6/6 faster parent and 0/6 faster assembly.
* BenchmarkVP8PickerFilterNative/pitch1312/mixed: 1.0230x parent, 1.0107x unrolled narrow loads, 0.9168x assembly; 6/6 faster parent and 0/6 faster assembly.
* BenchmarkVP8PickerFilterNative/pitch1312/noop: 1.1211x parent, 1.0762x unrolled narrow loads, 1.9943x assembly; 6/6 faster parent and 6/6 faster assembly.

This is a smaller consistent component improvement, not a new1.5x gain.
Previously accepted >=1.5x gather and other component wins remain intact,
independently of whole-encoder timing. Active textured filters still trail
assembly; flat/ramp/noop controls beat assembly. Do not generalize their ratio
to textured work or the complete codec.

Whole synthetic720p VP8, realtimeCPU8,2500kbps,one thread, six fresh balanced
three-way permutations, all23 non-timing result fields exact and zero allocations:

* 300 frames: -0.5704% encode time versus parent (5/6 faster), +9.6678% versus assembly (0/6 faster).

* 60 frames: -0.6884% encode time versus parent (4/6 faster), +10.6055% versus assembly (0/6 faster).

Validation: complete native ./... PASS; existing7200 fusion cases plus640
zero-correction/later-edge cases, decline guards, race/checkptr2 PASS; six
fixed-speed packet/drop digests exactly match the previously validated PR35
results. Final root refreshed PGO, noasm/build-selection/precommit and full
suite logs are included. Validation and raw logs are included. The regenerated vertical hot body exactly
matches all698 timed instruction words and self-relative rendered branches.
Calls to initial-load/final-store helpers and cold stack growth remain; counts
are diagnostic rather than speed/acceptance rules. AMD generated source and
ARM horizontal function remain byte-identical to parent. Independent review
symbolically checked every lane of both transpose schedules and carried values.

Rejected probes and qualitative profile remain preserved in this archive:
direct signed widening multiply for macro coefficients9/18/27, with generic
int16 fallback for full helper contract, passed all256signed bytes across13
coefficients/extreme ranges. Two balanced100ms diagnostics show no useful
active-filter gain; no production promotion. Fixed-edge narrow-load unroll
alone gives about1–5% diagnostically; wide-load winner is confirmed freshly.
A separate horizontal fixed-edge unroll, based on the accepted vertical variant,
shows only mixed/small active-work differences in two diagnostic rounds
(0.991–1.015x textured,1.013–1.039x identity controls). It is preserved without
production promotion or a claim of a new1.5x gain.
The first wide-load compile had an unused first-edge variable; fixed retry is

source_scope_proof.amd_report:
# AMD subpixel row-load candidate, native performance pending

Parent c3930581; AMD production is identical to mergedmainf56c66d7. This targets
subpelStats16, sampled at0.22sflat/0.24scumulative in PR35's4.52s EPYC7763 VP9
profile. That short profile establishes liveness, not the cause of the measured
VP9 regressions. Existing VP9 kernel controls stayed approximately flat.

Keep all AVX2 sixteen-pixel arithmetic, two bilinear rounding steps, paired
dot-product accumulations and deferred upper-lane fence. Replace repeated row
slices by exact16-byte array loads only after an OR/shift guard proves every
geometry component nonnegative and below2^30. With public w,h positive and
w divisible16, source/ref endpoints and even final unused row increments stay
below2^60. The original two endpoint checks prove all reads, including the
extra bilinear row/column, without padding. Zero/overlap strides and mutually
aliased read-only inputs remain valid. The original checked-slice function is
kept byte-identical after renaming for unusualgeometry, preserving its previous
overflow/panic behavior. No pointer is stored or retained.

Independent review passed bounds, overflow, carries/lifetimes, copied fallback
arithmetic and fixture fairness. Initial wrapper added a hot call; its source
and codegen remain archived. Final selected fast function has no added hot
helper call. Diagnostic cross-codegen drops243 to191 instruction lines and12
to2 bounds-panic sites; only the entry checks remain. Counts are not native
latency or acceptance evidence. All existing qualifying kernels remain intact.

Rosetta correctness only: existing full signed/extreme SubpelSixteenLane tests;
12,288 new legal-phase/alias/zero-overlap-stride/minimal-window cases plus
unusual rs1<<30/MAXINT h1 fallback and short-span panic checks; final root AMD
checkptr2 run passes. Full public DSP all-phase/size tests pass, actual AVX/AVX2
off fallback passes, and all40 new fixtures pass for candidate, CPUoff and
pinned assembly. Emulated ns/op values in1x smoke logs are not speed evidence.

New B.Loop public fixtures:16x8/16x16/32x16/16x32, five phases(fullpel,
horizontal-only,vertical-only,half,both), minimal and unequal padded strides.
Sources start at unaligned3/5, visible spans are exact and backing buffers
include checked read-only canaries. Independent scalar per-pixel equations
retain both rounding stages; final variance and SSE, full input immutability
and observable sinks keep work live. Pinned assembly's phase shortcuts are
legitimate algorithms and remain in the comparison.

Native harness preserves all206 older cases and adds the identical40 fixture
source to ASM/main/current, for246 total, six balanced permutations at150ms.
It records seven benchmark/production hashes and requires selected/extreme
pixel tests, all public subpixel tests and targeted race/checkptr2 before any
timing. Existing35-minute allowance remains. Merge/performance selection waits
for exact-head native results; no current x64 speedup or regression fix claimed.
README files, dependencies, project assembly exclusion and generic fallbacks
remain unchanged. Root PGO/validation logs are preserved with their results.

pr_snapshot.body:
The ARM VP8 vertical filter repeatedly packs scalar row loads and computes dynamic indices for its three fixed internal edges. Use 16-byte SIMD row loads and fixed edges 8/12/16 while retaining the exact signed arithmetic, carried corrected neighbors, and packed stores. The existing guard proves the complete 20×16 window, including minimal unaligned slices; wider loads add no padding requirement. ARM horizontal and x64 generated code stay unchanged.

Separately, replace repeated x64 subpixel row slices with exact SIMD array loads after a bounded-geometry proof and the original two endpoint checks. Preserve the original checked-slice implementation for unusual geometry and retain identical two-pass rounding, accumulations, read-only aliases, and AVX upper-lane fence. Independent review and Rosetta selected/checkptr/AVX-disabled/public scalar-oracle checks pass; native performance is pending, with no x64 speedup or VP9 regression-fix claim yet. Add 40 identical public rectangle/phase/minimal/padded fixtures to ASM/main/current, preserving all 206 old cases (246 total), seven source hashes, required full subpixel tests, and targeted native race/checkptr checks.

Native Apple M4 Max, Go 1.27.2 archsimd, PGO off, six fresh balanced parent/assembly/current permutations plus the narrow-load unrolled control:

- All **60 public Picker-filter pairs** improve versus the parent, with zero allocations. Active textured cases improve **1.023–1.030×**, and flat/ramp/no-op cases **1.093–1.121×**. This is a smaller consistent gain, not a new 1.5× result. Previously verified ≥1.5× kernels remain intact.
- Whole VP8 720p: **−0.570% encode time** over 300 frames, 5/6 pairs faster; **−0.688%** over 60 frames, 4/6 faster. All 23 output/control fields match, with zero allocations. The assembly gap remains **+9.668% / +10.605%**; active textured filters still trail assembly.

Validation: full native suite before and after refreshed PGO; 7,200 fusion/scalar cases plus 640 zero-correction/later-edge cases; race/checkptr2; six identical packet/drop digests; independent bounds/carry/lane-order review; generated instruction words exactly match the timed prototype; noasm/build-selection/precommit gates. Raw samples, source snapshots, qualitative profile, and unselected widening-multiply/horizontal probes are preserved under benchmarks. README files and dependencies unchanged.

Archive PR35's complete native x64 and optimized-libvpx evidence separately: EPYC 7763 VP8 time −7.659% versus main / −20.790% versus old assembly; retained VP9 controls +1.907% / +0.688% versus main while still beating assembly. Separate EPYC 9V45 fixed-quality VP8 encode time is 2.415902× optimized libvpx (+141.5902%; libvpx is faster) with matched measured quality/output counts. All regressions, the assembly allocation outlier, raw samples, and workload limits remain included.
